title: Law to protect reproductive care, not just abortion, from enforcement
summary: This bill expands an existing city law barring the use of city resources to help enforce restrictions on abortion so it covers all reproductive health care, including fertility treatments like IVF. It would stop city employees, contractors or property from being used to detain people connected to reproductive care or to share identifying information with out-of-state agencies. Exceptions remain for investigating care not performed under applicable law and for scientific research.
